interface.shortDescription: Build reliable cross-system and human-in-the-loop processes
interface.longDescription: Build reliable cross-system and human-in-the-loop processes: the workflow that fires when a customer upgrades, the nightly sync between two SaaS tools, the refund that waits for approval. Faceted-router skill covering 12 primary jobs (reconciliation, integration reliability, compensation and recovery, credentials and connections, approval and authority, trigger design, sync semantics, workflow observability, cost and quota, platform selection, workflow testing, process capture) across 4 base surfaces — hosted iPaaS (Zapier, Make), self-hosted engine (n8n, Windmill, Activepieces, Kestra), code-first durable execution (Temporal, Inngest, Restate, Step Functions), platform-native (cron) — plus an additive agentic overlay. Reconciles against the vendor's authoritative state rather than the system's own record of what it told it, treats compensation as a forward action rather than a rollback, and defaults to a solo/small-team posture where independence comes from the source, the clock, or a pre-committed rule rather than a second approver.
defaultPrompt: Use $automation to design a Stripe-to-CRM sync that survives a missed webhook.
